subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this auth-profile migration fix land as-is with the current focused proof, or should maintainers require broader shipped-shape/security review before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes upgrade-time persistence of OAuth and SecretRef credential material, which repository policy treats as compatibility and security-boundary sensitive.

options.title: Land after owner pass
options.body: Accept the focused before/after proof and merge once an auth/security owner confirms the credential-preservation contract.

options.title: Ask for broader shipped-shape proof
options.body: Require one more regression or proof case from an observed shipped legacy auth shape before merge.

options.title: Hold for related auth migration work
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want this field-preservation fix bundled with the separate runtime-import or flat-store merge PRs.

recommendation.title: Land after owner pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused before/after proof and merge once an auth/security owner confirms the credential-preservation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile migration surface traces most clearly to the merged SQLite auth-profile refactor, making steipete the best available routing owner from the history examined.
